Reasoning: This grasp stage keeps the panda_fingertip contact pose fixed while establishing a real grasp on strawberry_center_frame. freeze_position enforces the no-more-than-0.01 m fixed fingertip origin requirement. freeze_orientation enforces the current orientation hold with the requested 0.05 rad tolerance and does not impose any extra tool +z or +y relation. object_grasped is used instead of close_gripper because the stage requires a successful physical hold of strawberry_center_frame, not merely mechanical finger closure; the gripper_closed condition records the intended closed gripper state. No-slip contact is represented by requiring the object to be grasped while the end-effector pose is frozen. The API has no explicit fields for simultaneous left/right finger commands, individual joint-state feedback, gripper squeeze-effort thresholds, or fail/pause monitoring logic; those are therefore noted as unrepresented beyond the object_grasped success requirement and pose tolerances.
